title: Welcome to Irshad!
content: Let's take a quick tour to help you navigate your halal investments and understand the platform's features.

title: Your Portfolio
content: Track your holdings, view your overall performance, and monitor halal compliance all in one place.

title: Market Screener
content: Filter, sort, and discover new shariah-compliant companies across the entire stock market, and click on any stock to view its detailed AAOIFI Stage 1 and Stage 2 compliance breakdown.

title: Dividend Purification
content: Easily calculate and manage the purification of impure dividends using our built-in tracker.

title: Zakat Calculator
content: Keep track of your Zakat obligations based on your liquid assets and active holdings.

title: Updates & News
content: Stay informed with the latest market news, notifications, and platform updates.
